newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 200 MW firm power for Wed, prices up.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 200 MW firm power for Wed, prices up.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 400 megawatts of firm power during heavy loads hours on Wednesday and increased prices by $1.75 per megawatt hour (MWh), the federal agency said Tuesday.
BPA had offered 200 MW of firm, on-peak power for Tuesday. The agency continued to refrain from offering power during light-load hours or any non-firm power.

For Wednesday, BPA offered firm power during heavy load hours (0700-2200 PST) at $29.50 per MWh for Northwest deliveries, up from $27.75 for Tuesday. California-Oregon border deliveries were offered at $30.25, up from $28.50.
